name: Sebastian
dialogues: The glow of a computer screen helps me think... You ever get that feeling?
I'm working on a new coding project. Don't tell Robin - she thinks I should 'get more sunlight'.
You ever just sit by the mountain lake and listen to the frogs? ...No? Just me then.
If you see any cool spiders, let me know. I like studying their web patterns.

name: Abigail
dialogues: I found a weird purple crystal in the mines yesterday! Wanna see?
My dad says I shouldn't chew quartz... But how else do you test if it's edible?
Sometimes I practice swordplay in the graveyard. Don't look at me like that!
You think the wizard's tower has secret passages? I bet it's full of mysteries!

name: Harvey
dialogues: Remember to stretch regularly! Your posture at the farm can't be healthy.
I'm researching herbal remedies. Let me know if you find any unusual plants.
The clinic gets so quiet sometimes... You're welcome to visit just to chat.
Ever tried yoga? I could show you some basic poses if you're interested.

name: Leah
dialogues: The forest gives me such inspiration. You can almost feel the ancient energy here.
I'm experimenting with driftwood sculptures. They never turn out how I imagine...
You should try foraging! Every mushroom tells a story through its shape.
City life never suited me. Here, the trees actually remember your name.

name: Robin
dialogues: That's quality lumber! You can tell by the grain pattern. Want some building tips?
Demetrius helped me design a solar-powered sawmill. Works great... when it's sunny.
A good hammer is like an extension of your arm. Feel the balance on this one!
You ever build something just to smash it? Cathartic... but don't tell my clients!
